overview_description.description: Fresh & More is an online ordering service specializing in consolidating numerous healthy foods. We aggregate healthy meals through restaurants located in Amman and provide them to our customers through a user friendly, online ordering system. We focus on ensuring an informative and enjoyable experience by presenting each meal with nutritional labels, thus, making it impossible for them to make unhealthy decisions.
